problem:
Evaluate the triple integral

$$
{∭}_{R}2x\,\text{d}V
$$

where $R$ is the type III region given by 

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,{x}^{2}\le z\le 2{x}^{2},\,0\le y\le 2xz}.
$$
worked_solution:
Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}2x\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}{\int }_{0}^{2xz}2x\,dy\,dz\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}{\int }_{0}^{2xz}2x\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}[{\int }_{0}^{2xz}2x\,dy]dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}2x[y]_{y=0}^{y=2xz}dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}2x(2xz)\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}4{x}^{2}z\,dz\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}4{x}^{2}z\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{{x}^{2}}^{2{x}^{2}}4{x}^{2}z\,dz]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}2{x}^{2}[{z}^{2}]_{z={x}^{2}}^{z=2{x}^{2}}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}2{x}^{2}((2{x}^{2})^{2}-({x}^{2})^{2})dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}6{x}^{6}\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}6{x}^{6}\,dx & ={[\frac{6{x}^{7}}{7}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{6}{7}.\end{aligned}
$$
